ai_summary: **Executive Summary: AASTHA SPINTEX LIMITED Q1 FY27 Unaudited Results**  Aastha Spintex Limited reported unaudited Q1 FY27 results with a 35.6% year-over-year increase in Profit After Tax to INR 309.28 Lakhs, primarily driven by improved cost efficiency through inventory adjustments despite a 15.8% decline in revenue. A red flag is the substantial sequential decline in both revenue and profit from the prior quarter. Materially, the company completed an Initial Public Offering (IPO) after the quarter end, which increased share capital by approximately 40% and will significantly dilute future Earnings Per Share.
